description:
As we journey along the Essex Coastal Scenic Byway, you will have the freedom to discover at your own pace. Whether you're drawn to the breathtaking vistas, the working harbors, the quaint villages, the world-class art and culture, the distinctive local food, or the unique shops, the choice is yours to explore.
Gloucester is home to America's oldest seaport, the birthplace of the U.S. fishing industry, and the oldest continuously operating artists' colony on Rocky Neck. It offers a rich maritime history, fresh-caught seafood, an active working waterfront, and several beautiful beaches.

At the northernmost tip of Cape Ann, you'll find the picturesque seaside village of Rockport, MA. With Bearskin Neck and its many shops, studios, and restaurants jutting out from the town's center into its charming harbor, Rockport is a place of inspiration. In Rockport, we will also visit the Halibut Point State Park, a place that offers epic ocean views that will surely inspire you.
